title: 同相比例放大器
statement: 图示为理想运放构成的同相比例放大器，v_s = 2 V，R_1 = 10 kΩ，R_f = 20 kΩ。
求电压放大倍数 v_o/v_s、输出电压 v_o 和 R_1 中的电流 i_1。

questions.explain: v_o = 3 × 2 V = 6 V，与 v_s 同相（同号）。
虚短：v_n = v_{+} = v_s = 2 V，i_1 = v_n/R_1 = 2/10k = 0.2 mA；虚断使这一电流全部来自 R_f。

questions.ask: 从电压源 v_s 看进去，放大器的输入电阻是多少？
choices: 无穷大（v_s 不提供电流）
choiceExplain: R_1 是反相放大器的输入电阻。同相放大器中 v_s 接在同相端，不经过 R_1，R_1 中的电流来自运放输出端。
R_1、R_f 中的电流由运放输出端经 R_f、R_1 流到地，并不来自 v_s；由“虚断”，同相端不取电流。
questions.explain: v_s 直接接在同相输入端，由“虚断”i_{+} = 0，电源不输出电流，所以输入电阻为无穷大——这是同相放大器相对反相放大器的主要优点。

hints: 先用“虚短”求反相端 n 的电位。
R_1 与 R_f 串联构成对 v_o 的分压器：v_n = v_o·R_1/(R_1 + R_f)。
solution: **2. 虚断：** 反相端不取电流，R_1 与 R_f 中是同一个电流 i_1 = v_n/R_1 = 2/10 kΩ = **0.2 mA**。
**4. 放大倍数：** v_o/v_s = 1 + R_f/R_1 = **3**（总是 ≥ 1，输出与输入同相）。

en.title: Non-inverting amplifier
statement: The ideal op-amp forms a non-inverting amplifier with v_s = 2 V, R_1 = 10 kΩ, R_f = 20 kΩ.
Find the voltage gain v_o/v_s, the output voltage v_o and the current i_1 in R_1.

questions.explain: v_o = 3 × 2 V = 6 V, in phase (same sign) with v_s.
Virtual short: v_n = v_{+} = v_s = 2 V, so i_1 = v_n/R_1 = 2/10k = 0.2 mA; by the virtual open this whole current comes through R_f.

questions.ask: What is the input resistance of the amplifier seen by the source v_s?
choiceExplain: R_1 is the input resistance of the inverting amplifier. Here v_s drives the non-inverting input and does not feed R_1; the current in R_1 comes from the op-amp output.
The current in R_f and R_1 flows from the op-amp output through R_f and R_1 to ground; it does not come from v_s, because the non-inverting input draws no current (virtual open).
questions.explain: v_s is connected straight to the non-inverting input, which draws no current (virtual open). The source delivers no current, so the input resistance is infinite — the main advantage over the inverting amplifier.

hints: Use the virtual short to get the potential of the inverting node n.
R_1 and R_f in series form a voltage divider across v_o: v_n = v_o·R_1/(R_1 + R_f).
solution: **1. Virtual short:** v_n = v_{−} = v_{+} = v_s = 2 V.
**2. Virtual open:** no current enters the inverting input, so R_1 and R_f carry the same current i_1 = v_n/R_1 = 2/10 kΩ = **0.2 mA**.
**4. Gain:** v_o/v_s = 1 + R_f/R_1 = **3** (always ≥ 1, output in phase with the input).
